More about Swipe
Made with AI Edit
Swipe is a free Goods and Services Tax (GST) billing software that caters to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs). The software provides a comprehensive solution for businesses to manage their sales, purchases, and estimates in real-time. Swipe's primary market is businesses that require efficient inventory management and GST filing.
Swipe's revenue model is not explicitly stated, but free software typically monetizes through premium features, advertising, or data analytics.
Swipe's inventory management feature allows businesses to download reports on current inventory and update inventory quantities in bulk. This is particularly useful when adding new inventory.
